messages.text: Sign me up for the annual plan, how do I pay?
Great, I'll send the link.
I'm ready to start today. What's the next step?
Let's get you onboarded.
Can I book a call with the team this week?
Absolutely, here's my calendar.
This looks like what we need. How do I join the program?
Here is the signup page.
Honestly it's too expensive for us right now.
I understand, let's look at options.
Our budget is tight this quarter, is there a cheaper tier?
We have a starter plan.
The cost is hard to justify for a team of two.
Let me share ROI examples.
Do you offer a discount if we pay yearly?
Yes, two months free.
I can't log in to the community since yesterday.
Sorry about that, resetting access.
I was charged twice this month.
I'll check the invoices now.
The video player is not working on my phone.
Which device are you on?
I'm locked out after changing my email.
Let me fix the account link.
I think I'm going to cancel after this month.
Can I ask what changed?
Haven't had time to use it. Can I pause my membership?
We can pause for 30 days.
I'm not using the content anymore, want a refund.
Let me look at your options.
A friend recommended another tool, I might switch to it.
Happy to hear what it does better.
What topics does the Tuesday workshop cover?
Hiring, delegation and pricing.
Is the book included in the membership?
Yes, a digital copy.
Where can I find the replay of last week's event?
In the Events tab.
Who runs the weekly Q&A sessions?
The coaching team.
Is it worth it at that rate? I'm weighing it against my other commitments.
Many members see ROI in 90 days.
Between us, I'm not sure this is for me anymore.
Thanks for being honest.
Nothing loads when I open the app, just a blank screen.
Can you try updating it?
Who do I talk to about getting my whole team in?
I'll connect you with sales.
